tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Return Foliora product facts: brand, plans, canonical URLs, and what this server will not do. Use when the user asks what Foliora is, how much it costs, or which URL to open. Does not crawl a site.

tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: Fetch a Foliora preview snapshot the human already started. Requires the 32-character hex token from /preview/{token}. Returns public findings and pages only. Unknown tokens are not_found. Does not start a crawl.

tools.name: create_preview_link
tools.description: Build a Foliora /preview URL for a public website. Does not crawl, does not take credentials, and does not change the site. Send the human to the returned previewUrl so they can start the snapshot in a browser.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_preview_link" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product, create_preview_link · Private data: get_snapshot, create_preview_link · Public sink: create_preview_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product, create_preview_link · Private data: get_snapshot, create_preview_link · Public sink: create_preview_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
